questions.prompt: The severe judge and the truthful witness were feared by the guilty.
questions.answer: Iūdex sevērus et testis vēridicus ā nocentibus timēbantur.

questions.prompt: The gentle words of the poet soothed the troubled minds.
questions.answer: Verba mītia poētae animōs turbātōs mītigābant.

questions.prompt: Long are the roads that lead to the barbarian kingdoms.
questions.answer: Longae sunt viae quae ad rēgna barbara dūcunt.

questions.prompt: The measured verses and the honorable deeds are praised by all.
questions.answer: Versūs mēnsī et facta honesta ab omnibus laudantur.

questions.prompt: The dear friend and her stern mother are coming into the city.
questions.answer: Amīca cāra et sevēra māter in urbem veniunt.

questions.prompt: The mingled crowd shouts, while the fearful leader remains silent.
questions.answer: Turba mixta clāmat, dum dux timidus tacet.

questions.prompt: The greedy kings, having been warned, feared the coming war.
questions.answer: Rēgēs avidī, monitī, bellum ventūrum timēbant.

questions.prompt: Bright are the stars which shine over the quiet fields.
questions.answer: Clārae sunt stēllae quae super agrōs quiētōs nitent.

questions.prompt: The old man and the wise woman composed a long tragedy together.
questions.answer: Senex et fēmina sapiēns longam tragoediam ūnā composuērunt.

questions.prompt: The frightened soldiers, roused by the trumpet, seized their weapons.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs territī, tubā inrītātī, arma rapuērunt.

questions.prompt: The teacher's precepts were harsh, but the students were grateful.
questions.answer: Praecepta magistrī sevēra erant, sed discipulī grātī erant.

questions.prompt: Great is the desire for glory in the brave young men.
questions.answer: Magna est cupiditās glōriae in iuvenibus fortibus.

questions.prompt: The mixed wine and the sweet honey were placed on the table.
questions.answer: Vīnum mixtum et mel dulce in mēnsā posita sunt.

questions.prompt: The words spoken by the truthful old man moved the assembly.
questions.answer: Verba dicta ā sene vēridicō contiōnem mōvērunt.

questions.prompt: The gentle mistress and her faithful maid were walking through the garden.
questions.answer: Domina mītis et ancilla fīda per hortum ambulābant.

questions.prompt: Heavy are the burdens which the weary farmers carry home.
questions.answer: Gravia sunt onera quae agricolae fessī domum portant.

questions.prompt: The fierce general, having been provoked, threatened the trembling captives.
questions.answer: Dux ferōx, inrītātus, captīvīs trementibus minābātur.

questions.prompt: The honorable senators and the loyal citizens defend the ancient laws.
questions.answer: Senātōrēs honestī et cīvēs fidēlēs lēgēs antīquās dēfendunt.

questions.prompt: The character of the man is upright, and his deeds are praised.
questions.answer: Mōrēs virī honestī sunt, et facta eius laudantur.

questions.prompt: The savage storm and the raging sea terrified the sailors.
questions.answer: Saeva tempestās et īrātum mare nautās terruērunt.

questions.prompt: The girl, warned by her stern father, feared the terrible punishment.
questions.answer: Puella, ā patre sevērō monita, poenam timendam metuēbat.

questions.prompt: The customs of the barbarians are cruel, and their kings are proud.
questions.answer: Mōrēs barbarōrum crūdēlēs sunt, et rēgēs eōrum superbī sunt.

questions.prompt: The composed matron and the eager children awaited the promised gifts.
questions.answer: Mātrōna composita et līberī cupidī dōna prōmissa exspectābant.

questions.prompt: The brave soldiers, wearied by long marches, sought their distant camp.
questions.answer: Fortēs mīlitēs, longīs itineribus fessī, castra remōta petēbant.

questions.prompt: The steep mountains are covered with deep snow.
questions.answer: Arduī montēs profundā nive teguntur.

questions.prompt: The wise judge and the honest witness were praised by the citizens.
questions.answer: Sapiēns iūdex et probus testis ā cīvibus laudātī sunt.

questions.prompt: The exiled king, having lost his kingdom, wandered through remote lands.
questions.answer: Rēx exsul, rēgnō āmissō, per terrās remōtās errābat.

questions.prompt: The eager students write letters with careful hands.
questions.answer: Studiōsī discipulī litterās dīligentibus manibus scrībunt.

questions.prompt: The exempt citizen and the free soldier owe no tribute.
questions.answer: Cīvis immūnis et mīles līber nūllum stipendium dēbent.

questions.prompt: The generous queen gave great rewards to the loyal attendants.
questions.answer: Rēgīna benefica magna praemia fīdīs ministrīs dedit.

questions.prompt: The swift rivers flow down from the snowy mountains.
questions.answer: Rapidī fluviī dē montibus nivōsīs dēfluunt.

questions.prompt: The lethal poison and the hidden dagger were found in the chest.
questions.answer: Venēnum lētāle et pūgiō occultus in arcā inventa sunt.

questions.prompt: The tired travelers, oppressed by the summer heat, rested in the shade.
questions.answer: Fessī viātōrēs, aestīvō calōre oppressī, in umbrā quiēscēbant.

questions.prompt: The words of the eloquent orator were pleasing to all.
questions.answer: Verba disertī ōrātōris omnibus grāta erant.

questions.prompt: The pious daughter and the devout son honored the household gods.
questions.answer: Pia fīlia et pius fīlius Penātēs coluērunt.

questions.prompt: The steep road was long and difficult for the weary legions.
questions.answer: Via ardua fessīs legiōnibus longa et difficilis erat.

questions.prompt: The frightened horses, terrified by thunder, fled across the open field.
questions.answer: Territī equī, tonitrū perterritī, per apertum campum fūgērunt.

questions.prompt: The bright stars shine in the silent sky.
questions.answer: Clārae stēllae in silentī caelō lūcent.

questions.prompt: The greedy merchant and the deceitful moneylender were hated by the poor.
questions.answer: Avārus mercātor et fallāx faenerātor ā pauperibus invīsī erant.

questions.prompt: The sick old man needs quiet and gentle care.
questions.answer: Aeger senex quiēte et lēnī cūrā eget.

questions.prompt: The victorious soldiers, adorned with laurel, entered the joyful city.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs victōrēs, laurō ōrnātī, laetam urbem intrāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The letters written by the learned poet are still read.
questions.answer: Litterae ā doctō poētā scrīptae adhūc leguntur.

questions.prompt: The cruel tyrant and his savage soldiers destroyed the ancient temple.
questions.answer: Crūdēlis tyrannus et saevī mīlitēs antīquum templum dēlēvērunt.

questions.prompt: The deep waters of the swift river are cold and clear.
questions.answer: Altae aquae rapidī flūminis frīgidae et pūrae sunt.

questions.prompt: The faithful dog, guarding the threshold, frightened the bold thief.
questions.answer: Fīdus canis, līmen custōdiēns, audācem fūrem terruit.

questions.prompt: The golden apples hang from the sacred tree.
questions.answer: Aurea māla ā sacrā arbore pendent.
